draft_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling decodes faster than Talmar, with a median latency of 41 vs 118 ms per utterance.
revised_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling's median latency was 41 ms per utterance versus 118 ms for Talmar, though the two were measured under different conditions (Brisling on Corvex A2 fp16 in this work; Talmar on Corvex A1 fp32, as reported by Ruiz-Hale et al., 2023).
rationale: Numbers (41 vs 118 ms) match T1.r1.lat and T1.r2.lat. However, the comparison is not directly comparable: Brisling was timed on Corvex A2 fp16, Talmar's latency was copied from its paper measured on Corvex A1 fp32. The claim omits this measurement-condition difference, overstating the comparison.
